mathematical_definition.working_definition: A Calabi-Yau n-fold is, under a common mathematical convention, a compact complex Kähler manifold with trivial canonical bundle / vanishing first Chern class, with additional assumptions varying by convention. Yau's theorem supplies a Ricci-flat Kähler metric in each Kähler class when c1=0.
core_conditions: d omega=0 for Kähler form omega
there exists a nowhere-vanishing holomorphic top form Omega on a Calabi-Yau with trivial canonical bundle

cy3.generic_holonomy: SU(3) for an irreducible simply connected Calabi-Yau threefold under the usual assumptions
cy3.importance: Six real compact dimensions are exactly what a 10D superstring compactification needs to reach four large spacetime dimensions.

dimensional_bookkeeping.ten_to_four: 10D superstring spacetime -> M^(3,1) x X_6. Taking X_6 to be a Calabi-Yau threefold is a canonical route to a four-dimensional effective theory. Details of supersymmetry and particle content depend on string theory, bundles/branes/fluxes and other choices.
dimensional_bookkeeping.eleven_to_four: 11D M-theory -> 4D requires seven compact internal real dimensions. For minimal 4D supersymmetry a standard geometric route uses a seven-manifold with G2 holonomy, not an ordinary Calabi-Yau threefold by itself.
dimensional_bookkeeping.eleven_to_five: 11D M-theory compactified on a Calabi-Yau threefold (six real dimensions) naturally yields a five-dimensional effective theory before any further reduction.
dimensional_bookkeeping.project_repair: Tim's phrase '11d Calabi-Yau' should therefore be preserved historically but split scientifically into several possibilities: 10D string on CY3 -> 4D; 11D M-theory on CY3 -> 5D; 11D M-theory on G2 seven-manifold -> 4D; or more elaborate staged compactifications.
dimensional_bookkeeping.door_insight: Dimension 5 can remain a project Door coordinate without claiming that CY3 itself supplies the project's exact 5D threshold.

hodge_numbers: h^(1,1)(X): counts Kähler-type deformation directions in the simplest CY3 discussion
h^(2,1)(X): counts complex-structure deformation directions in the simplest CY3 discussion
hodge_moduli_structure.moduli_message: Hidden geometry is not one number. A compactification typically has continuous deformation parameters/moduli describing size/shape/complex structure before stabilization effects are included.
hodge_moduli_structure.project_use: This is a rigorous correction to vague 'hidden dimensions': hidden dimensions can have many internally distinguishable geometric degrees of freedom even when the large-dimensional observer sees only an effective low-energy theory.

mirror_symmetry.core: Calabi-Yau threefolds can occur in mirror pairs X,Y whose associated string/sigma-model physics is equivalent in an appropriate sense while geometrical data are exchanged.
hodge_exchange: chi(Y)=-chi(X) for mirror CY3 pairs under the standard exchange
mirror_symmetry.structural_insight: Two geometrically/topologically distinct presentations can encode equivalent physical content. This is a much stronger and more exact Mirror/Twin comparator than visual bilateral symmetry.
mirror_symmetry.project_boundary: Mirror symmetry does not imply that any two spiritually 'mirrored' people, symbols or histories are physically dual Calabi-Yau compactifications.

syz_duality.proposal: Near suitable large-complex-structure/large-volume limits, mirror CY3s are expected to admit dual special-Lagrangian T^3 fibrations; mirror symmetry is related to fiberwise duality/Fourier-Mukai/T-duality ideas.
special_lagrangian_conditions: Im Omega|_L=0 (after the appropriate phase convention)
syz_duality.project_connection: This supplies a rigorous mathematical neighbor for 'same underlying relation, different projection': the transformation acts along hidden torus fibers rather than simply reflecting a picture.
syz_duality.deep_mirror_law: A useful Timic Mirror should specify what structure is exchanged, what invariant physical content survives, and what transformation maps one description to the other.

compactification_as_projection.schematic: Pi_low: (M_large x X_internal, fields) -> effective low-dimensional fields/couplings
compactification_as_projection.kk_mass_template: m_n^2=m_0^2+lambda_n/R^2 in natural-unit schematic form, where lambda_n arises from an internal-space eigenvalue problem; exact spectra depend on geometry.
compactification_as_projection.meaning: Low-dimensional observers can see towers of effective modes whose masses/couplings encode the hidden internal geometry.
compactification_as_projection.project_use: This is a precise way to talk about hidden House structure influencing visible manifestation without saying the compact dimensions are directly visible rooms.

cycles_branes_and_intersections.cycles: Nontrivial homology cycles are important because strings/branes and fluxes can wrap or thread them, producing effective particles, fields, potentials or charges in lower dimensions depending on the construction.
cycles_branes_and_intersections.project_connection: Door and House become richer when 'hidden room' means a cycle/fiber/modulus with a defined topological role rather than an unnamed extra direction.
cycles_branes_and_intersections.boundary: A theological room is not a brane cycle; the preserved structure is hidden internal organization with observable lower-dimensional consequences.

topology_change_and_conifold.concept: Calabi-Yau families can develop singular limits; conifold transitions and related string-theoretic resolutions provide real examples where topology can change through a singular/critical geometry in an enlarged physical framework.
topology_change_and_conifold.door_connection: This is a sophisticated external neighbor for Door-as-topology-change: approach singular configuration -> new light degrees of freedom/description -> resolution/deformation -> different topology.
topology_change_and_conifold.warning: Do not import 'death/rebirth' or biography into conifold physics. The value is the existence of mathematically controlled topology-changing transitions in string theory.

g2_bridge.definition: A seven-dimensional Riemannian manifold with holonomy contained in G2 is Ricci-flat and carries a covariantly constant spinor under appropriate conditions; G2 compactifications are central in 11D M-theory routes to 4D N=1 theories.
g2_bridge.timic_relevance: G2 is the correct high-value correction to the project's tendency to call all hidden 6-11 dimensional geometry 'Calabi-Yau'.
g2_bridge.singularities: Gauge sectors/chiral matter in realistic G2 compactifications generally require suitable singular structures rather than a completely smooth generic compact G2 manifold.
g2_bridge.project_rule: Use CY3 for six-real-dimensional string compactification structure and G2 for direct seven-real-dimensional M-theory-to-4D comparison unless a different compactification is explicitly defined.
